## Purpose

`golem-tools` provides the tool definition, execution, registry, and resilience infrastructure for Bardo Golems to safely invoke DeFi protocol operations. It defines `ToolDef` (static tool metadata), `ToolContext` (execution environment injected into every handler), `ToolExecutor` (capability-gated async runner), and registry systems (`ToolRegistry`, `ProfileRegistry`, `ALL_TOOL_DEFS`) that organize 423+ read/write/privileged tools across Uniswap, Aave, Morpho, Pendle, Lido, EigenLayer, GMX, and other protocols. Tools are simulated before execution using Revm and validated against risk policies via `golem-safety::Capability` tokens and `CircuitBreaker`/`RateLimiter` resilience guards.

## Key Invariants

- Capability token value must not exceed per-transaction limit: `capability.value_limit_usd <= 10,000 USD` (numeric constraint on `CapabilityLimits`).
- `ALL_TOOL_DEFS` is immutable `&'static` slice; tools are registered at compile time by Plans 27–35, not at runtime.
- `ToolRegistry` maps `&'static str` tool names to `&'static ToolDef` references; names are stable identifiers that must not collide.
- `RateLimiter` token bucket refill rate must match configured throughput; `CircuitBreaker` state machine is strict: Closed → Open → Half-Open → Closed.
- Every tool invocation receives a fully populated `ToolContext` with GolemId, EventFabric, AuditChain, block state, and Capability tokens; no tool executes without context.
- Revm simulation state must not affect on-chain state; all write operations are broadcast only after simulation succeeds and audit entry is logged.

## Public API

`ToolDef` — Static metadata: name, category, async handler, parameter JSON schema, risk tier, tick budget, required capability tier.

`ToolContext` — Execution environment: GolemId, EventFabric, AuditChain, block number/timestamp, Capability token pool, optional GrimoireWriter.

`ToolResult<T>` — Output envelope: value, ground-truth fields (actual_gas_used, actual_balance_delta, simulation_time_ms), audit flags.

`ToolError` — Thiserror enum: parameter validation, capability denial, simulation failure, RPC timeout, sandbox violation, external tool timeout.

`CapabilityTier` — `Read` / `Write` / `Privileged` — determines which tools may execute.

`RiskTier` — `Layer1` / `Layer2` / `Layer3` — maps to `golem-safety` risk engine layers.

`TickBudget` — `Fast` (~5ms) / `Medium` (~50ms) / `Slow` (~500ms) — execution time limit per tool.

`SpriteTrigger` — `Thinking` / `Executing` / `Success` / `Failure` — animation/UI events for render layer.

`ToolCategory` — 17-variant enum: `Uniswap`, `Aave`, `Morpho`, `Pendle`, `Lido`, `EigenLayer`, `GMX`, `Yearn`, `Data`, `Safety`, `Intel`, `Memory`, `Identity`, `Wallet`, `Vault`, `Stream`, `Bootstrap`.

`ToolProfile` — 14-variant enum: `MinimalRead`, `CoreTrading`, `LPManagement`, `Lending`, `Staking`, `Vault`, `Safety`, `Intelligence`, `Memory`, `Identity`, `Wallet`, `Streaming`, `Advanced`, `Admin`.

`ProfileRegistry` — `HashMap<&'static str, HashSet<ToolCategory>>` — resolves profile name to enabled tool categories.

`ToolExecutor` — Async executor: validates capability, simulates via Revm, executes on-chain, returns `ToolResult<T>`.

`ToolRegistry` — `HashMap<&'static str, &'static ToolDef>` — global tool lookup by name.

`ALL_TOOL_DEFS` — `&'static [&'static ToolDef]` — immutable compile-time tool slice; aggregated by `tools::mod.rs`.

`ProviderPool` — Alloy provider factory with moka LRU cache (100-connection max); caches by chain ID.

`SubgraphClient` — HTTP client for The Graph subgraph queries; handles JSON-RPC, retries, deserialization.

`RateLimiter` — Token bucket (governor crate) — per-tool rate limiting.

`CircuitBreaker` — Per-dependency failure tracker; transitions Closed → Open → Half-Open → Closed.

`ToolsConfig` — TOML-deserializable config: profiles, rate limits, circuit breaker thresholds, subgraph endpoints, provider pool size, optional grimoire sidecar.

`MockTool` — Reference implementation in `tools::mock.rs`; template for Plans 27–35.

## Dependencies

`golem-core` — CognitiveTier, GolemId, EventFabric, event enum for audit trails and execution context.

`golem-chain` — ChainProvider, ChainRegistry, RevmSimulator for fork-based simulation.

`golem-safety` — Capability<T>, ActionPermit, AuditChain, AllowList for policy enforcement.

`mirage-rs` (feature: `library`) — StateDiff, SpeculativeExecutor, MirageClient for transaction simulation.

`golem-grimoire` (feature: `memory`, optional) — GrimoireWriter for memory sidecar integration.

`alloy` — EVM provider, RPC types, HTTP transport for state queries and transaction broadcast.

`moka` — async LRU cache for provider pool and subgraph responses.

`reqwest` — async HTTP client for subgraph and external JSON-RPC endpoints.

`tokio` — async runtime (features: `full` for channels, timers, sync primitives).

`governor` — token bucket rate limiting.

`serde`, `serde_json`, `toml` — serialization for ToolContext, ToolResult, config deserialization.

`thiserror` — error enum derivation.

`uuid` — v4 UUIDs for audit trail and permit IDs.

## Implementation Notes

- `ToolDef` and `ToolResult<T>` should be `Copy` or cheap-to-clone; handlers pass them frequently.
- `ToolContext` is large; wrap in `Arc` when cloned across task boundaries (async spawning).
- `ToolExecutor::execute()` is async; call only within Tokio runtime; no blocking on `.await` in sync code.
- Handler signature: `async fn handle(params: serde_json::Value, ctx: &ToolContext) -> Result<ToolResult<T>, ToolError>`. Parameters must deserialize from JSON.
- `Capability<WriteTool>` tokens are consumed on invocation (Rust move); one-time use only.
- `ALL_TOOL_DEFS` is immutable and `'static`; tool registration is compile-time only (Plans 27–35).
- `RateLimiter` and `CircuitBreaker` initialize at executor startup, not per invocation.
- Subgraph responses may be stale; validate against chain state for critical operations (e.g., price oracles before swaps).
- Revm simulation bugs can diverge from on-chain execution; always validate post-broadcast.

## Test Requirements

Integration tests in `crates/golem-tools/tests/`; unit tests via `#[cfg(test)]` in source files.

Cover:
- `test_tool_def_parse_schema()` — ToolDef JSON schema deserialization.
- `test_executor_capability_denied()` — WriteTool denied to Read context; confirm `ToolError::CapabilityDenied`.
- `test_executor_simulate_and_execute()` — simulate, inspect deltas, execute, compare results.
- `test_rate_limiter_exhaustion()` — token bucket empty; confirm next invocation fails or delays.
- `test_circuit_breaker_state_transitions()` — trip after N failures; verify Half-Open probe; confirm recovery.
- `test_profile_registry_resolve()` — load profile; verify category membership.
- `test_mock_tool_invocation()` — invoke MockTool via executor; confirm output shape and audit entry.
- `test_capability_value_limit()` — verify `value_limit_usd <= 10_000`.
- `test_provider_pool_cache()` — moka LRU hit/miss and eviction.
- `test_tool_registry_lookup()` — ALL_TOOL_DEFS slice indexing and ToolRegistry consistency.

## Do Not

- Do not execute a tool handler without `ToolContext` injection; audit trails and capability checks are mandatory.
- Do not block on `ToolExecutor` in synchronous code; causes task starvation. Use `.await` only in async contexts.
- Do not register new tools to `ALL_TOOL_DEFS` at runtime. Tool registration is final at compile time; runtime modifications break audit integrity.
- Do not ignore tripped `CircuitBreaker` state; a breaker in Open must block calls until recovery window expires. Retrying during Open masks systemic failure.
